networkMethod: Unmodified live Ahrefs and Cloudflare SDKs; SDK-generated pageviews and production RUM must be positive. Context-wide interception checks URL, headers and body before sending, including popups and pagehide beacons. Only an explicitly authorized HTTPS OpenStreetMap navigation may carry the disclosed synthetic GPS. All analytics/map endpoints are intercepted; no provider ingestion receipt is claimed. File fixtures have unique filename, author, GPS and SHA computed before selection. No actual file was uploaded.
localSkips: Two Firefox synthetic-origin tests: dedicated Worker dynamic imports bypass context.route; exact assertions run on the real production origin in Firefox.
Two CPU/network throttling tests use Chromium-only CDP and are inapplicable to Firefox/WebKit.
failureHistory: Initial simultaneous build/unit run: PDF test hit unchanged 5-second timeout, 286 pass/1 fail; isolated rerun and both clean-worktree unit runs 287/287.

Affected UI regression: 235/246 pass; ten tests used obsolete details/export controls or ambiguous selectors, repaired by actual UI interaction with all data/format/dimension assertions retained; one Gmail239 external ERR_CONNECTION_CLOSED. Entire image-viewer plus Gmail case rerun 29/29.
Initial analytics Chromium: 1/2 pass because native middle-button autoscroll consumed later Clear click. Explicit Escape and strengthened empty-state assertions; no product change.
First clean build: two strict tuple typing errors in new tests; fixed with readonly tuple and clean build passed.

Cross-engine preview mapping: Firefox Host inherited synthetic name (403), WebKit blob resources erroneously treated as HTTP; corrected. Remaining Firefox Worker dynamic imports cannot resolve synthetic origin; minimal comparative probe recorded, full production assertions mandatory.

Initial production 78-case batch: 77/78, Firefox Clear after auxiliary click received trusted pointer/mouse down/up but browser suppressed click; event-probe reproduction retained. Native focus+Enter activates Clear with every original and strengthened empty-state assertion unchanged. Both production Firefox scenarios passed with downloadCount=0.
Initial visual audit: mobile submenu links 42px versus required44. CSS fixed, four-width menu regression added; final release and production verification required.
First static robots comparison parser reported CRLF/LF mismatch despite equivalent rules; original JSON retained and parser corrected. No HTTP/robots permission failure.
